source_read: the eight Hoburne Autumn/Winter 2026 menu PDFs under https://www.hoburne.com/assets/PDF-Downloads/Autumn-menu-2026/ (re-downloaded 2026-10-08 without the ?vid= query string, as robots.txt requires; byte-identical to the morning copies)
notes: Calories-only chain, no allergens published (link-only). Re-running hoburne_holidays.py on the fresh PDFs reproduces data/source byte for byte. The 12 audit-sample rows (Californian Cobb sa 532, tofu vegan swap 1191, Herb Roasted Potatoes 538, Iced Matcha 152, Cheesy Baked Beans 759, Trillionaire Tart 694, Poached-egg breakfast 966, Milkshake 698, Bourbon BBQ Melt 753, K Pop cauli swap 622, Mississippi burger 1373, tofu add-on 139) were read on rendered pages (Clubhouse p3, Restaurant p2, Venue, Breakfast p2, Sunday p2, Sweet Treats p2) and match, including tags (vg/v marks, bacon). Separately, a text-layer value-set check over all 8 PDFs: every published calorie value occurs in a PDF (Americano/Espresso print 1kcal) and every PDF value is either published or an excluded conflict between menus, a per-100ml plant milk, The Bay's unlabelled roll/sandwich pairs, or the '2000kcal a day' footer. Item-to-number mapping for the other 189 items rests on the script's positional guards, not on my page-by-page reading.
